description: Changes a site's display name (shown in list_sites and the dashboard). Plain text; HTML entities like ' are decoded. Max 120 characters. Signed-in accounts only. Free.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

name.description: The new display name, plain text, e.g. "Pappy's Place". HTML entities are decoded. Max 120 characters. One of name / page_title is required; page_title alone retitles the home page without renaming the site.

og_image_url.description: Optional link-preview (share card) image for the home page: an https:// image URL, max 500 characters. Without it, the first image on the page is used.

page_description.description: Optional search-snippet and link-preview description for the home page, 1-300 characters. Write a sentence that makes sense on its own (it is shown out of context). Without it, the first text on the page is used.

page_title.description: Optional browser-tab / search title for the home page (max 70 characters). Without it, a default home title such as "My Page" (or the old site name) is replaced by the new name; a custom title is kept.

site_key.description: The site to rename. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

stage.description: true = put the home page title change on the staged copy (publish_staged makes it live). The operator token always stages on a published site.

name: rename_site
title: Rename a site
